findings.detail: synthesize() merges member risk_flags with dict.update in id order (last-wins). A regulatory_burden=True from one source is silently clobbered by False from a later-id source, and the candidate escapes KILL. The kill engine's sole job is acting on explicit flags; the merge can erase them deterministically-but-arbitrarily. Same shape for metrics (keywise franken-merge across sources; conflict case untested — mesh slice uses identical metrics so merge is invisible).
findings.fix: OR-merge boolean risk flags (any True wins); for metrics keep per-source or document last-wins explicitly + pin a conflict test
findings.title: risk_flags last-write-wins can erase True kill evidence; metrics silently mixed across sources

findings.detail: calculate_score accepts any int/float except bool. float('nan') yields a NaN score (not UNKNOWN); float('inf') yields an inf score that sorts FIRST and tops the portfolio. Requires NaN/inf in facets (hand-crafted or a leaky bridge).
findings.title: non-finite metrics (NaN/inf) produce NaN scores / top the portfolio

findings.detail: dedupe() and detect_contradictions() index thought['summary'] directly while neighboring code uses .get('summary',''). A summary-less dict crashes with KeyError. Mesh path always sets summary, so direct-API/dirty-input only.
findings.title: KeyError on missing summary in dedupe/contradictions
